answer: Sterilize each endoscope individually secured in a sterilization container. Only endoscopes marked “autoclave” may be autoclaved: clean thoroughly, steam at 134°C for 5–8 minutes, and allow to cool to room temperature. Do not expose unmarked endoscopes to temperatures above 60°C; use chemical sterilization according to the manufacturer’s instructions. Use each device in approved endoscopic procedures by physicians experienced in endoscopy
